{{Top|leg}}
The '''command/control module''' was the primary processing unit of a [[Drone barge/Legends|drone barge]]. It was preprogrammed with all liftoff, flight, and landing data to control the unmanned barge, including [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel. On their mission to [[Orron III]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and her crew took the place of the module in a hijacked barge shell. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] [[Computer/Legends|computers]] handled the command/control module duties.
